adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.createEvent the calendar is now selected via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and if no match is found it silently falls back to `"primary"` (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). The diff does not add any explicit test coverage for this new selection behavior or for the new interface contract `createEvent(event, credentialId)` beyond updating an unrelated Playwright expectation (`destinationCalendar: []`). While the fallback-to-primary may be intentional, it is a real, diff-grounded edge-case/scope concern: events could be created on the wrong calendar when destination calendars exist but none match the credentialId, without an error.
